name: Cyberpunk
blurb: Synthwave night city: deep violet-black surfaces, neon pink and cyan glow, holographic gradients and retro-future chrome type.

tagline.en: Neon glow on a synthwave night

origin.note: Original spec written for this collection, synthesizing the shared conventions of the cyberpunk/synthwave web revival (neon palette, glow shadows, scanlines).
